actual_starter_use: postgame only, for participation and grading
agreement_gate: multi-book agreement required on the same canonical goalie
evaluation_denominator: exclude nonstarters from the scored evaluation denominator
identity_gate: exactly one unique goalie per canonical game-team
market_listing_claim: availability signal only; never starter confirmation
scoring_population_stability: to preserve retained probabilities, construct/transform the complete immutable slate feature snapshot once, then apply the market-listed eligibility gate; do not refit batch preprocessing on a filtered subset
starter_representation: no representation of projected or confirmed starter status
